- When reviewing pull requests, do not rely only on the PR title, labels, or autogenerated dependency bump message. Inspect the actual diff and describe likely behavior, tooling, security, and compatibility impact.
- For dependency, workflow, or lockfile bumps, deeply inspect what actually changed and which config/runtime paths in this dotfiles repo are affected. For lockfile-only dependency bumps, identify the upstream project and review the commit range, release notes, changelog, or upstream diff between the old and new versions; do not treat the lockfile version/hash change as the whole change.
